summary: Group 1 Automotive filed an 8-K disclosing a September 21, 2026 Stockholder Agreement with Conifer Management and affiliates, settling an activist campaign. The board will expand from ten to eleven directors and appoint Conifer analyst Benjamin Hart effective November 1, 2026. Conifer agreed to vote with board recommendations during the Support Period, with discretion on Extraordinary Transactions, and to customary standstills capping ownership at 19%, plus proxy-solicitation and competitor-investment limits. No price, premium, or termination fee is stated. Watch whether board influence converts into strategic or capital-allocation changes.
